title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Meeting: PM <> Eng lead 1:1 (prep)
Date/time: 2026-02-26 10:00 AM PST
Attending: Priya (PM), Ethan (Eng lead), Alex (Product eng support, async), Sam (SRE - optional)
Purpose: sync on priorities across API, Console rollout, Dedicated capacity requests, and Private customer onboarding. Identify blockers and assign follow-ups.

Agenda
1) Quick status (5m)
   - API health: token-based usage stable; p50 p99 latency trends look OK but saw a small regression after the quantization change last week.
     * Metric snapshot: API p50 ~ 48ms (down from 45ms target), p99 ~ 420ms (spiky at peak).
     * Note: percent of requests hitting cache prefix ~ 32% (goal 40%).
   - Console rollout: internal beta complete, leak in route mapping fixed, need to sign-off on telemetry retention UI.
   - Dedicated: two large customers (AcmeCorp, FinNova) requesting >2x their committed throughput next quarter.
   - Private: onboarding for BetaBank still in pre-install; KMS/HSM integration outstanding.

2) Decisions needed (10m)
   - Dedicated quota bump for AcmeCorp: can we provision an extra 8 GPUs for Apr 1? (Decision required by 2026-03-05)
   - Console telemetry retention default: 30 days vs 90 days for enterprise tier? Need final call to update UX copy and API.
   - Private onboarding scope: do we include HSM integration in the initial on-prem bundle or deliver it as an add-on?

3) Blockers Deep-dive (15m)
   - Performance regression after quantization refactor (PR #512): appears to affect KV cache hit latency under long-tail seq lengths.
     * Action: Ethan to run perf repro (microbench + e2e) and capture flamegraphs by 2026-02-27.
     * If repro confirmed, revert the refactor for 1.2.x patch and land a safer incremental change.
   - Dedicated scheduling policy: autoscaler sometimes overshoots causing noisy neighbor for reserved pools.
     * Action: Alex to open JIRA ENG-3421 with a clear acceptance test and resource isolation proposal by 2026-02-28.
   - BetaBank KMS: security review flagged missing attestation flow.
     * Action: Sam to draft attestation design & compliance checklist; coordinate with security by 2026-03-03.

4) Roadmap sync (10m)
   - API: small features to ship this sprint: structured output v2, streaming improvements (backpressure fix). Priority: structured output (customer requests).
   - Console: telemetry audit UI + rollout plan for enterprise customers (canary to 5 internal teams this week).
   - Dedicated: prioritize autoscaler fixes + faster provisioning path for quota increases.
   - Private: finalize installer automation for Ubuntu 22.04; HSM auth deferred unless AcmeCorp pays for premium onboarding.

5) People / team notes (5m)
   - Engineering bandwidth: Ethan mentions two ICs out this week (vacation) - may impact perf repro timeline.
   - Hiring: still interviewing for infra eng (req 237).

Action items (with owners & target dates)
- Ethan Park: run perf repro + flamegraphs for quantization regression; decide revert vs patch. Due 2026-02-27. (Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/512)
- Alex Morgan: create JIRA ENG-3421 with autoscaler isolation proposal + acceptance tests. Due 2026-02-28.
- Sam Jensen: draft KMS/HSM attestation design & compliance checklist, sync with security. Due 2026-03-03.
- Priya Shah (me): update Dedicated pricing note for prospect deck and confirm with revenue ops the provisioning timeline; follow up with AcmeCorp on hard deadlines. Due 2026-03-01.
- All: quick daily stand this week if perf repro is flaky (15m sync) - optional depending on progress.

Notes to self / talking points
- Start with wins: console beta internal feedback mostly positive (quote: "telemetry helped debug route mismatch quickly"). Make sure to call out that we shipped canary toggle.
- Emphasize product-first tradeoffs: HSM is sticky sale but heavy lift; propose staged approach (basic installer -> HSM add-on).
- Ask Ethan: worst-case for reverting quantization change (impact on other tests, rollout plan for patch).
- Ask Alex: any quick wins to improve cache prefix hit (config change? TTL tweak?) that don't require kernel-level work.

Follow-ups to include in meeting notes (post-call)
- Send short summary + action items to #eng-runtime and product slack channel. Ping assignees and include links to JIRA/PR.
- Attach perf artifacts (flamegraphs, traces) to Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-PI-ROLLOUT.
- Update roadmap doc with any date shifts (notify stakeholders).

Loose ideas / brainstorm (scratchpad)
- Telemetry retention: maybe make default 30d but provide one-click upgrade to 90d for enterprise with a cost toggle in console.
- Dedicated fast-path: pre-warm instance pool for high-probability quota increases (cost vs latency tradeoff).
- Private onboarding: offer a "bare-metal quickstart" that excludes HSM and then upsell HSM integration.

Unresolved questions (prep to ask)
- Can SRE bump ephemeral capacity for one week to repro perf at scale? (Sam)
- Is there a short-term config change to KV cache TTLs that increases prefix hit for common workloads? (Alex)

Draft slack post after meeting (copy)
"Quick update from today's PM/Eng lead 1:1: perf regression after quantization refactor under investigation (Ethan to repro), autoscaler isolation ticket opened (Alex), KMS attestation design in progress (Sam). Action owners + due dates in the doc. Will follow up with perf traces and Confluence link."

Version notes
- v0.1 (2026-02-20): initial prep draft
- v0.2 (2026-02-25): added action owners and dates, linked PR/JIRA/Confluence refs

End of doc.
